verdict.rationale: DBOS documents patching and versioning strategies for upgrading workflow code, and Conductor is described as letting you monitor, version, fork, and replay workflows. You can review checkpointed steps and audit logs. Rollback is execution-level only: fork or restart from a step. Nothing shows reverting a workflow definition to a prior version. Workflows are plain Python, so code review and testing fall to the user's own tooling. Missing for 10: documented rollback of workflow code/version deployments, a first-party review/approval flow for automation changes, and independent hands-on corroboration of versioning.
